def test_check_if_last_char_is_a_letter():
# nonce:04ab0b8a
    # Last token is a single lowercase letter -> True
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple pi e") == True
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("hello world a") == True
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("I am a i") == True

    # Single uppercase letter -> True (lowered before check)
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("A") == True
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("foo bar Z") == True

    # Boundary alphabet characters 'a' and 'z'
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("x y z") == True
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("q w a") == True

    # Characters just outside the letter range
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("a b `") == False   # ord 96
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("a b {") == False   # ord 123

    # Digits and symbols are not letters
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("hello 1") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("hi !") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("test @") == False

    # Last token longer than one character -> False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple pie") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("I am ai") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("hello world!") == False

    # Empty string and trailing whitespace -> False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter(" ") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("apple pi e ") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("z ") == False

    # Multiple consecutive spaces: last non-empty token counts
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("a  b") == True
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("a  bc") == False

    # Mixed case within words
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("Hello World") == False
    assert check_if_last_char_is_a_letter("Hello Worl d") == True
